_readme: Settings for the test report generator. Edit values, keep the structure.
Cell names (D7, J24, ...) are the cells of templates/test_report.xlsx; PDF and Word use the same layout.
In texts, \n is a line break and ^{2} is a superscript 2 (Kgs/Cm^{2}).
Random ranges: min and max are both possible; 'decimals' is how many decimals are printed;
'step' (optional) is the smallest change, e.g. 0.05 gives values like 1.55 or 2.30, 5 gives 600, 605, 610.

report._help: Report No. counts 1, 2, 3... in generation order (PE 63, then PE 80, then PE 100, top to bottom). Editable before generating.
report.file_name: Production column D (REPORT NO.) with / replaced by -, e.g. MP100/019 -> MP100-019

header_cells._help: Where each value from the production row goes.

chart_cells._help: Specification limits looked up in the IS 4984 weight chart (data/is4984_chart.json) by DN and SDR.

random_values._help: Test values obtained. New random values every time a report is generated.

pipe_end._help: Range depends on the chart's Pipe End maximum (E20). Only this value ends in 0 or 5.

outside_diameter._help: Both inside the chart OD min-max (E24-E25), never exactly on a limit; obtained minimum is below obtained maximum.

wall_thickness._help: Both inside the chart wall min-max (E26-E27), never exactly on a limit; obtained minimum is below obtained maximum.

ovality._help: Kept a decent distance from 0 and from the chart maximum (E28).

melt_flow_rate._help: Ranges must not overlap so PE 100 < PE 80 < PE 63 always holds.

empty_cells._help: Test values left empty for now (units stay).

fixed_text._help: Every fixed text of the report. Same on every report.
fixed_text.D14:
